title: WildRoot
description: Optimized cozy Minecraft but made for casual explores, builders, pvp'ers and everything in-between with vanilla in mind!
body:
WILDROOT is a modpack for casual players looking for a new experience, but still want to keep the charm of vanilla Minecraft. It's all about discovery, creation, and better world generation. The pack improves the game with gorgeous landscapes, new structures, and immersive environments that make every adventure feel thrilling and rewarding.

WILDROOT keeps mechanics simple and familiar with vanilla gameplay in mind, but improves the overall experience with carefully selected enhancements. The pack also has a good balance of cozy home building, world exploration, as well as a laid back survival experience with friends. Whatever your play style is, this pack has something for you!

The optimization mods and shader support help to deliver smooth performance and a more atmospheric world with visual improvements without losing the classic Minecraft feel.
